title: 4Dhouse Bando HTX Phenom Bando Drops Electrifying New Single “Chain On”
htmlContent:
4Dhouse Bando is back with a bang, teaming up with in-house producer Thizaezbeat for his latest release, “Chain On.” This track has a tailor-made vibe for getting dressed, pre-gaming, and setting the tone for unforgettable nights. Following his hit “Sack” with label mate 4, “Chain On” cements Bando’s status as an artist to watch in 2024.

From the first beat, “Chain On” grabs you and doesn’t let go. Thizaezbeat’s production is a masterclass in modern hip-hop, seamlessly blending infectious rhythms with hard-hitting bass lines that demand to be blasted at full volume. Bando’s lyrical prowess shines through, delivering playful and profound verses, encapsulating the essence of youthful exuberance and ambition.

Rodney Jones, better known as Bando, is no ordinary teenage rapper. Hailing from Houston’s historic Fourth Ward, Bando’s journey from local talent to a signed artist with Danuel House Jr.’s 4DHouse Ent and Steve Stoute’s United Masters is nothing short of meteoric. Despite only seriously pursuing music since 2022, his work ethic and natural talent have already set him apart in a crowded field.

With over 100K+ streams on his previous release, “Sack,” proves he’s here to stay. This latest single offers a tantalizing glimpse into what fans can expect from his upcoming EP, Bando Tape.

In “Chain On,” Bando transforms everyday moments into extraordinary experiences, making it the perfect soundtrack for any occasion. Whether you’re hitting the town or cruising through the city, this track promises to elevate your night.
